scope: Shared disposable panel CLI acceptance, readiness under request saturation, minimal configuration projections, initialization reuse, embedded asset readers and reconnect cancellation

ci_failure.step: Real panel API contracts in isolated development mode
ci_failure.diagnostic: yg-vpngate: 面板监听 IP 或端口无效
ci_failure.cause: init attempted to persist 127.0.0.1:0; ephemeral ports are only supported by no-system serve
ci_failure.fix: test-panel-local.mjs initializes valid saved settings, overrides the loopback listener only during serve and waits for worker readiness through /healthz

environment.host: Windows amd64, Intel Core i5-9400F, Go 1.27.3, Node 24.18.0
environment.cores: sing-box 1.14.4, Mihomo 1.19.33; managed-core built with with_quic,with_utls,with_wireguard
environment.concurrent_work: Other tests and a QEMU VM ran during the allocation benchmark; timing samples are diagnostic only

checks.windows_final_asset_health_initializatio: passed after final embedded reader change
checks.windows_go_vet_all: passed; affected packages rechecked after final change
checks.npm_test: passed: six suites, including new cancellation of a pending reconnect check
checks.shellcheck_warning: passed: sb.sh, install.sh, lib/*.sh and scripts/*.sh
checks.shared_cli_acceptance: passed twice using built Windows manager and managed-core; account binding/export, sharing, download limits, candidate preview and durable apply
checks.saturated_health: passed: 32 held application requests do not block local worker readiness; not-ready worker remains unavailable
checks.configuration_snapshot: passed: pending desired revision 2 and applied revision 1 are returned together, without changing applied data
checks.linux_amd64_regressions: passed in dedicated Ubuntu VM: readiness saturation/local peer, invalid initialization, projection retry, embedded asset conditional cache and desired/applied revision separation
checks.linux_shell_acceptance: passed: upgrade active/stopped/rollback and deferred receipts, installer ownership and installer contracts; ShellCheck warning level passed
checks.github_ci: The containing commit must be checked in GitHub Actions; earlier successful runs are not evidence for this change

configuration_read_benchmark.fixture: Same WAL/FULL SQLite database; desired and applied each contain about 1 MiB
configuration_read_benchmark.interpretation: Desired-only allocation is approximately 50% lower than full-state allocation; no claim of proxy throughput or whole-process RSS improvement

cleanup.disposable_panel_roots: Removed after successful acceptance and child process close
cleanup.validation_processes: Stopped; dedicated Linux VM shut down before moving artifacts
cleanup.temporary_artifacts: Recursive deletion was rejected by automatic policy; .test and .build moved together to ignored .cleanup-manual for manual deletion
cleanup.retained: Current toolchains and VM disks, development dependencies, regression fixtures, historical evidence and third-party licenses

limitations: Windows race detection was not run locally; the GitHub workflow runs the full Linux race suite
No physical phone, production VPS, public ACME issuance or long-duration saturation test in this change
The local readiness bypass still shares the server connection limit; it only bypasses the application request gate
